items.title: Lee Collins Interview, 1958-06-02
items.q: With a very good piano player, Bill I wish you'd heard him, you knocked him out. A boy from Kansas City called Udell Wilson.

ctx.x: So I said, when did y'all go home?

Joe and Joe say, we go to work in three weeks. So I got the blues for old New Orleans, the old gang, the good old street parades and all the good old places where we used to play at. So I slipped off from Joe and went back, bought me a ticket and went back home, went back to New Orleans because I had improved all night on my cornet and technique was better and everything was better by playing with all fine musicians too. Old Joe had filled on that trombone. So I go back. Oh, it was the thrills of their life that…
Oh, I heard, yeah, Manuel Moneta talking about it. And Manuel Moneta was in the band.
